This '''clone pilot''' participated in the [[Sky Battle of Quell]] and operated a [[Consular-class cruiser (Charger c70 retrofit)/Legends|''Consular''-class cruiser]].

==Biography==
This pilot was part of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's]] rescue team to save master [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] and the remaining [[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone troopers]] inside her flagship the [[Liberty (Venator-class)/Legends|''Liberty'']]. After evacuating the survivors, the pilot allowed [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Bly/Legends|CC-5052]] to take his place in the ship's bridge and raise the deflector shields.<ref name="Jedi Crash" />

The ship was damaged when multiple [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droids]] fired at the ship. In the end, the ship cashed on [[Maridun/Legends|Maridun]]. The pilot died in the crash.<ref name="Jedi Crash" />
